tutorial.welcomeDesc: Let us give you a quick tour of the app so you can start creating professional quotes in no time.
tutorial.stepAiChatDesc: Start here! Describe the job to the AI and it will generate a professional quote for you. You can type or use the microphone.
tutorial.stepFillQuoteDesc: When the AI has a quote ready, tap this button to automatically fill in all the fields below.
tutorial.stepNotepadDesc: Jot down notes on-site, even by voice. Then send them to the AI chat to turn them into a quote.
tutorial.stepQuoteFormDesc: This is where your quote lives. Add services, set pricing (per m², per hour, or fixed), and insert photo blocks.
tutorial.stepAddServiceDesc: Tap here to add more services to your quote. You can reorder them with the arrows.
tutorial.stepPhotoBlockDesc: Insert photos between services — great for showing the work area or materials to your client.
tutorial.stepPdfPreviewDesc: See your quote rendered as a professional PDF in real time. Everything you type above appears here instantly.
tutorial.stepDownloadDesc: Download the PDF to your device, or use the share buttons below to send it directly.
tutorial.stepActionsDesc: Send the PDF directly via Email, WhatsApp, or the system Share sheet. Customize the message above.
tutorial.stepSettingsDesc: Set up your company info, logo, brand color, currency, VAT, language, and more. These persist across all your quotes.
tutorial.stepMenuDesc: Access your saved quotes, AI conversations, AI preferences, and upgrade options from the sidebar.
tutorial.stepConversationsDesc: All your AI chat conversations are saved here. You can pin, rename, or delete them. Click on any conversation to continue where you left off.
tutorial.stepSavedQuotesDesc: Your saved quotes live here. You can load, rename, or delete any quote. Double-click on a name to rename it quickly.
tutorial.stepAiPrefsDesc: Fine-tune how the AI generates your quotes. Adjust detail level (simple vs detailed), market positioning (budget vs premium), and tone (casual vs formal).
tutorial.stepSidebarSettingsDesc: Jump to the full settings panel to configure your company info, logo, brand color, currency, and more.
tutorial.stepMediaUsageDesc: Track your monthly photo and document upload usage here. The bars show how much of your plan's allowance you've used.
